meta.title: 第44讲 · 主谓一致 自学
meta.subtitle: 自学一遍再上课：热身认识三原则 → 语法一致·必单数六情况 → 语法一致·必复数与陪衬结构 → 意义一致·上（整体一份算单数）→ 意义一致·下（family/means 两面派）→ 就近 vs 就远 → 综合验收（共 7 关 · 50 题。作业卷留到课后当考试，这里不剧透）

nodes.title: ① 热身：主谓一致，到底谁说了算
nodes.explain:
主谓一致的定义一句话：谓语动词与主语在人称和数上保持一致。听着简单，难在「怎么判断单复」——同一个名词，换个意思单复就翻面。全部考点归三条原则：

原则判断标准例句
语法一致主语形式单数 → 谓语单数；形式复数 → 谓语复数He does his homework every evening. / You and I are good students.
意义一致不看形式看意思The people are busy.（形式单数、意义复数）/ My family is big.（整体）/ My family are watching TV.（成员）
就近原则谓语只听最近的主语的Neither you nor he likes pop music. / Either he or I am responsible for the project.

本讲路线：②③关吃透语法一致（哪些主语必单数、哪些必复数、谁是陪衬），④⑤关拿下意义一致（一堆「看着像、其实不是」的两面派），⑥关搞定就近 vs 就远，最后综合验收。

自学方法：先读讲解 → 盖住答案做题 → 点「先想再看答案」核对 → 全懂了点「我学完了」进下一关。

general_qs.stem: 主谓一致指的是什么？
options: 谓语动词与状语在时态上保持一致
谓语动词与主语在人称和数上保持一致
主语与宾语在数上保持一致
谓语动词与表语在人称上保持一致
general_qs.answer: B. 谓语动词与主语在人称和数上保持一致
general_qs.explain: 定义背原句：谓语动词跟主语走，在人称和数上保持一致。A / C / D 死于「跟谁一致」的对象全找错了。

general_qs.stem: My family is big. 但 My family are watching TV now. 同一个 family，一个 is 一个 are，用的是哪条原则？
general_qs.explain: family 拼写没变，意思变了：is big 说「家」这个整体（单数），are watching 说「家人们」这群成员（复数）——形式让位给意义，正是意义一致原则。

general_qs.stem: Neither you nor he ________ pop music. 这句要靠哪条原则定谓语？
options: 语法一致：you 是第二人称
就近一致：谓语听最近的主语 he 的
general_qs.answer: C. 就近一致：谓语听最近的主语 he 的
general_qs.explain: neither…nor 连接两个主语时，谓语只看离它最近的那个——he 是三单，所以用 likes。这就是第⑥关要细练的就近原则。

general_qs.stem: Either he or I ________ (be) responsible for the project.
general_qs.explain: 就近原则：谓语和最近的主语 I 保持一致 → am。这题的考点不是人称有多难，而是「谓语跟着近邻变」这个意识。

general_qs.stem: He ________ (do) his homework every evening.
general_qs.explain: 最朴素的语法一致：He 三单 + every evening 一般现在时 → does。主谓一致的「一致」，从三单开始。

nodes.title: ② 语法一致·上：六种「必单数」主语
nodes.explain:
语法一致原则看形式：主语形式是单数，谓语就用单数。下面六种主语，出场即单数：

主语长这样例句
① 不可数名词 / 可数名词单数Water is very important to the trees.
② to do / doing 短语作主语To improve your English is the most important work. / Watching TV too much is bad for your eyes.
③ 不定代词（either, neither, each, one, another + some- / any- / no- / every- 系列）Somebody is waiting for you at the gate. / Nothing is too difficult.
④ one / each one / anyone + of + 复数名词One of the boys goes to school by car.
⑤ this kind of / a pair of / a piece of + 名词This kind of apples tastes sweet.
⑥ the number of + 复数名词（……的数量）The number of students is more than two thousand.

记法：④⑤⑥全是「量词打头」——真正的主语是 one / kind / pair / number 这些单数词，of 后面的复数名词只是陪衬，说了不算。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 1（上）：单数关（先想再点开）

general_qs.stem: Making a good weekly plan ________ very helpful for you to achieve your goals.
general_qs.explain: Making…plan 是动名词短语作主语 → 当单数 → is。B / C 死于 helpful 是形容词，前面要系动词 be，不能换成 have / has；D 死于把动名词主语当复数。

general_qs.stem: Watching TV too much ________ (be) bad for your eyes.
general_qs.explain: 动名词短语 Watching TV too much 作主语 → 一件事，单数 → is。看电视这件事「是」伤眼的，一件事用单数。

general_qs.stem: Somebody ________ (be) waiting for you at the gate.
general_qs.explain: somebody 属 some- 系列不定代词 → 单数 → is。别被「有人」的中文感觉骗成复数——some- / any- / no- / every- 系列全家单数。

general_qs.stem: Nothing ________ (be) too difficult if you put your heart into it.
general_qs.explain: no- 系列不定代词 nothing → 单数 → is。世上无难事，只怕有心人——nothing / nobody / no one 和 something / everyone 同命运。

general_qs.stem: One of the boys in our class ________ (go) to school by car.
general_qs.explain: one of + 复数名词：真正的主语是 one（其中一个）→ 单数 → goes。the boys 是 of 后面的陪衬，别看它复数就写成 go。

general_qs.stem: This kind of apples ________ (taste) sweet.
general_qs.explain: this kind of + 名词：主语是 kind（单数）→ tastes。后面用 apple 还是 apples 都不影响——kind 才是主语。

general_qs.stem: In our school, the number of men teachers ________ more than 100 now.
general_qs.explain: the number of + 复数名词 = 「……的数量」，中心词是 number（单数）→ is。C / D 死于句尾 now 锁死现在时；B 死于被 men teachers 带偏——「数量」这个数才是主语。

general_qs.stem: To improve your English ________ (be) the most important work.
general_qs.explain: 不定式 To improve… 作主语 → 单数 → is。to do 和 doing 作主语待遇相同：一律按单数办。

memory.front: 六种主语，谓语必用单数——分别是哪六种？
memory.back:
① 不可数名词 / 可数单数（Water is important.）
② to do / doing 短语（Watching TV too much is bad.）
③ 不定代词：some- / any- / no- / every- 系列、each、either、neither、one、another
④ one of + 复数名词（One of the boys goes…）
⑤ this kind of / a pair of / a piece of（This kind of apples tastes sweet.）
⑥ the number of + 复数名词（「数量」是单数）
一句话：量词打头（one / kind / pair / number），of 后面的复数只是陪衬

nodes.title: ③ 语法一致·下：必复数主语与「陪衬」陷阱
nodes.explain:
三条「必复数」，再加一组最爱设坑的「陪衬结构」：

情况规则例句
① and / both … and 并列两个（或以上）主语并列 → 复数He and his brother are both teachers.
② a number of + 复数名词= 许多 → 复数（对照：the number of 数量 → 单数）A number of students come from Sichuan.
③ 成对物体的名词（trousers, shoes, glasses 眼镜, socks, gloves, clothes…）本身按复数；但被 this / a pair of 修饰时 → 单数Her shoes are green. / This pair of shoes is very expensive.
④ 陪衬结构：with, together with, as well as, except, but, like 引导的短语谓语只跟前面的主语走（就远）Tom with his parents has gone to Beijing.

还有三个「看对象」的点：① none 指不可数 → 单数（None of the money is mine.），指可数 → 单复皆可（None of us knows / know…）；② 定语从句里 that / who / which 作主语，谓语跟先行词走（The students who are good at writing…）；③ 倒装句谓语跟后面的真主语（Here comes the bus. / There goes the bell.）。

记法：a number of 是「许多」（复数），the number of 是「数量」（单数）——多一个 the，单复数翻个面；with / as well as 一家是「陪衬」，决定谓语的只有最前面那个主语。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 1（下）：复数关与陪衬（先想再点开）

general_qs.stem: Both Lily and Mary ________ to take part in the competition and they decide to prepare for it together.
general_qs.explain: both…and 并列两个人 → 复数 → want。A 死于单数；C 死于后半句 decide 是一般现在时，前后时态要一致；D 死于 wanting 不能单独作谓语。

general_qs.stem: Tommy often with his family ________ to the park on weekends.
general_qs.explain: with his family 是陪衬，主语只有 Tommy（三单）→ goes。B / C 死于被 family 带成复数；D 死于 often 提示一般现在时，不能用过去式。

general_qs.stem: Sally as well as her parents ________ eating different kinds of delicious food.
general_qs.explain: as well as her parents 也是陪衬，主语 Sally 三单 → likes。A 死于单复数；C 死于 liking 不能单独作谓语；D 死于 be like 意思是「像」，这里要的是「喜欢」。

general_qs.stem: He and his brother ________ (be) both teachers.
general_qs.explain: and 并列两个主语（他 + 他哥，两个人）→ 复数 → are。对比第④关：and 连接同一概念（the poet and writer 一个人）才用单数，这里是两个活人。

general_qs.stem: A number of students ________ (come) from Sichuan.
general_qs.explain: a number of = 许多 → 修饰复数 students，谓语用复数 → come。和 the number of（数量，单数）是一对头号易混搭档：多一个 the 就翻面。

general_qs.stem: Her shoes ________ (be) green.
general_qs.explain: shoes 是成对物体的名词（两只算一双）→ 复数 → are。同类：trousers、glasses（眼镜）、socks、gloves、clothes。

general_qs.stem: This pair of shoes ________ (be) very expensive.
general_qs.explain: 一旦被 this pair of / a pair of 打头，主语变成 pair（单数）→ is。上一题 shoes 直接当主语是复数，戴上 pair 的帽子就单数——同一双鞋，两种待遇。

general_qs.stem: None of the money ________ (be) mine.
general_qs.explain: none 指不可数名词 money → 谓语单数 → is。none 指可数名词时单复皆可（None of us knows / know…），但指钱这种不可数，只能单数。

memory.front: a number of 和 the number of 怎么区分？with / as well as 后面的名词能决定谓语吗？
memory.back:
a number of + 复数名词 = 许多 → 谓语复数（A number of students come…）
the number of + 复数名词 = ……的数量 → 谓语单数（The number of students is…）
with / together with / as well as / except / but / like 引导的短语是「陪衬」，谓语只看前面的主语
成对名词 shoes / trousers / glasses 直接作主语 → 复数；this / a pair of 打头 → 单数
none 指不可数 → 单数；指可数 → 单复皆可

nodes.title: ④ 意义一致·上：形式像复数，其实当单数
nodes.explain:
意义一致原则看意思不看形式。先看「形式像复数、意义是单数」这一组：

主语规则例句
① 时间 / 距离 / 金额 / 重量（复数形式）当整体看 → 单数Three weeks is already enough. / Seventy miles is a long distance.
② and 连接同一人 / 同一事 / 同一概念一个 the → 同一个人，单数；两个 the → 两个人，复数The poet and writer has come.（一人）/ The poet and the writer have come.（两人）
③ 固定复合名词（fish and chips, bacon and eggs, bread and butter, a knife and fork…）一份东西 → 单数Fish and chips is a popular meal in Britain.
④ s 结尾但单数意义（news, maths, physics, politics）单数The good news is that our class won the game.
⑤ every … and every … / each … and each … / no … and no …两个 every / each 重复，仍单数Every boy and every girl has the right to get education.
⑥ many a / more than one + 单数名词意思「许多」，形式单数 → 谓语单数Many a student wants to be a spaceman like Yang Liwei.

记法：「整体一份算单数」——三个星期是一段时间、鱼和薯条是一份饭、诗人兼作家是一个人；many a / more than one 最别扭，意思明明「不止一个」，谓语偏用单数，因为核心词是那个 a / one。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 2（上）：意义一致·上（先想再点开）

general_qs.stem: Physics ________ my favorite subject.
general_qs.explain: physics 以 s 结尾，但是学科名 → 单数意义 → is。同类：news, maths, politics。C / D 死于 my favorite subject 前面要系动词 is，不是「拥有」。

general_qs.stem: Two weeks ________ not a long time, but you can do many preparations for your history report.
general_qs.explain: two weeks 是一段时间，当整体看 → 单数 → is。C / D 死于把「两个星期」当成两个东西；A 死于这是陈述一般事实，用现在时即可。

general_qs.stem: Three weeks ________ (be) already enough for you to finish the work.
general_qs.explain: 三个星期 = 一段时间的整体 → is。够不够说的是这段时间的总量，总量是「一个数」。

general_qs.stem: The poet and writer ________ already come.（那位诗人兼作家已经来了）
general_qs.explain: the poet and writer 只有一个 the → 同一个人（诗人兼作家）→ 单数 → has come。若写成 the poet and the writer，两个 the 就是两个人，才用 have。C / D 死于 come 是实义动词，完成时要借 has / have，不能用 be 动词。

general_qs.stem: Fish and chips ________ (be) a popular meal in Britain.
general_qs.explain: fish and chips 是固定复合名词 = 一份饭 → 单数 → is。同类：bacon and eggs、bread and butter、a knife and fork（一副刀叉）。不是随便两个名词 and 一下都复数。

general_qs.stem: The good news ________ (be) that our class won the basketball game.
general_qs.explain: news 以 s 结尾却不可数 → 单数 → is。news 是「消息」这个整体概念，不是「许多 news」。

general_qs.stem: Each teacher and each student ________ to attend the meeting.
general_qs.explain: each…and each…（以及 every…and every…、no…and no…）结构 → 一律单数；师生是「被允许」参加 → 被动 is allowed。B 死于复数；C / D 死于主动语态——主语不能自己 allow 自己。

general_qs.stem: Many a student ________ (want) to be a spaceman like Yang Liwei.
general_qs.explain: many a + 单数名词：意思「许多学生」，形式却是 a student → 单数 → wants。意义一致里最别扭的一条：意思很多，形式认一个。

memory.front: 意义一致·上：哪些主语形式像复数，却按单数办？
memory.back:
① 时间 / 距离 / 金额复数 → 整体，单数（Three weeks is enough. / Seventy miles is a long distance.）
② and 连同一人 / 同一概念 → 单数（The poet and writer has come.；两个 the 才是两人，用 have）
③ 复合名词 fish and chips / bacon and eggs / a knife and fork → 一份，单数
④ news / maths / physics / politics：s 结尾，意义单数
⑤ every…and every… / each…and each… / no…and no… → 单数
⑥ many a / more than one + 单数名词 → 谓语单数（Many a student wants…）

nodes.title: ⑤ 意义一致·下：两面派名词大点兵
nodes.explain:
再看反方向的一组：形式看不出复数（或干脆单数），意义却是复数：

主语规则例句
① people / police复数意义的集体名词 → 复数The police are asking them questions.
② the + 姓氏复数（the Smiths, the Greens）= 一家人 → 复数The Greens are going to have a picnic.
③ the + 形容词（the rich, the poor, the wounded）= 一类人 → 复数The rich are not always happy. / The wounded are still in hospital.
④ family / class / group / team整体 → 单数；成员 → 复数His family isn't large. / His family were watching TV.
⑤ 单复同形（fish, deer, means, species, series）看意思：单数意义 → 单数；复数意义 → 复数Every means has been tried. / The means of communication are interrupted.
⑥ and 连接两个 doing / to do不同概念 → 复数；同一概念 → 单数Reading and listening are good choices. / Respecting the old and taking care of the young is a good tradition.

记法：family 两面派——「家」是一个整体（is big），「家人」是一群人（are watching）；means 两面派——「每一种方法」（has been tried）单数，「多种通讯手段」（are interrupted）复数。判断标准只有一条：它指一个还是一群。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 2（下）：意义一致·下（先想再点开）

general_qs.stem: The Smiths often ________ in the mountains on the weekend. They really like to spend time with nature.
general_qs.explain: the + 姓氏复数（the Smiths）= 史密斯一家人 → 复数；often 提示一般现在时 → go camping。B / C 死于单数；D 死于 often 不能配进行时。

general_qs.stem: The police ________ (ask) them questions now.
general_qs.explain: police 是复数意义的集体名词（不说 a police）→ 谓语复数；now 提示进行时 → are asking。同类：people。

general_qs.stem: The rich ________ (be) not always happy.
general_qs.explain: the + 形容词 = 一类人（富人们）→ 复数 → are。the wounded（受伤的人们）、the poor（穷人们）同一待遇。

general_qs.stem: His family ________ (be) large.
general_qs.explain: 「家大不大」说的是「家庭」这个整体 → 单数 → is。同一个词，下一题立刻变脸。

general_qs.stem: His family ________ (watch) TV when I arrived.
general_qs.explain: 家人们正在看电视，说的是一个个成员 → 复数；when I arrived 过去时点上进行 → were watching。family 是单复切换的头号两面派。

general_qs.stem: Every possible means ________ to save his life.
general_qs.explain: every 锁定 means 的单数意义（每一种方法）→ 单数；方法是「被使用」→ 被动 → has been used。B 死于复数；C / D 死于主动语态——方法不能自己用自己。

general_qs.stem: Reading and listening to light music ________ (be) good choices to relax ourselves.
general_qs.explain: and 连接两个不同的动名词概念（阅读、听音乐是两件事）→ 复数 → are。对比：Respecting the old and taking care of the young is…（尊老爱幼算一件事）→ 单数。

memory.front: 意义一致·下：people / the Smiths / family / means 各自听谁的？
memory.back:
people / police → 复数（The police are asking…）
the + 姓氏复数 = 一家人 → 复数（The Greens are…）
the + 形容词 = 一类人 → 复数（The rich are not always happy.）
family / class / team：整体 → 单数（His family isn't large.）；成员 → 复数（His family were watching TV.）
means 单复同形：每一种 → 单数（Every means has been tried.）；多种手段 → 复数
and 连 doing：不同概念 → 复数；同一概念 → 单数

nodes.title: ⑥ 就近原则 vs 就远原则
nodes.explain:
就近原则：谓语的单复数不看全部主语，只看离它最近的那一个。登场的是「就近三剑客」和 there be 句型：

结构规则例句
either … or / neither … nor / not only … but also / or谓语跟最近的主语Neither you nor your father is able to help me. / Either you or I go swimming with our father.
there / here be + 并列主语be 跟第一个（最近的）主语There is a dictionary and some books on the desk.

对照就远原则（第③关的陪衬结构）：with / together with / as well as / except / but / like 引导的短语跟在主语后面时，谓语只认最前面那个主语——Tom with his parents has gone to Beijing.

记法：三剑客（either…or / neither…nor / not only…but also）把谓语拽向近处；陪衬团（with / as well as / except…）让谓语守住远方的主语。一个贪近，一个念旧，方向正好相反。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 3：就近 vs 就远（先想再点开）

general_qs.stem: Either Amy or her sisters ________ (plan) to go to the supermarket to buy fruit yesterday.
general_qs.explain: either…or 就近：离谓语最近的是 her sisters（复数）→ 谓语按复数走；yesterday 过去时 → planned。Amy 的三单念头千万别冒出来。

general_qs.stem: Not only my teacher but also my parents ________ (support) my dream, so I will try my best to make it come true.
general_qs.explain: not only…but also 就近：最近的主语 my parents 复数 → support（原形）。teacher 虽是三单，但它离得远，说不上话。

general_qs.stem: There ________ (be) a river and many flowers in the park near my home and I usually go for a walk along the river.
general_qs.explain: there be 并列主语就近：be 跟第一个主语 a river（单数）→ is。后面的 many flowers 再热闹也不管——就近只认第一个。

general_qs.stem: Neither his parents nor his sister ________ (be) to the Palace Museum so far.
general_qs.explain: neither…nor 就近：最近的主语 his sister 单数；so far 现在完成时 → has been。parents 复数的诱惑就摆在眼前，考的就是你敢不敢看近处。

general_qs.stem: Neither you nor your father ________ (be) able to help me.
general_qs.explain: 就近：最近的主语 your father 三单 → is。和讲义另一句 Either you or I am… 对照着记——同一结构，近邻换了人，谓语就跟着换。

general_qs.stem: Tom with his parents 与 Not only Tom but also his parents 作主语，谓语分别跟谁？
options: 前者跟 Tom（就远），后者跟 his parents（就近）
前者跟 his parents，后者跟 Tom
general_qs.answer: C. 前者跟 Tom（就远），后者跟 his parents（就近）
general_qs.explain: with 是陪衬，只作补充，主语还是 Tom → has gone；not only…but also 是就近结构，谓语被拽向 but also 后面的 his parents → 复数。一远一近，方向相反。

memory.front: 就近三剑客是哪三个？就远陪衬团有谁？
memory.back:
就近：either…or / neither…nor / not only…but also（+ or）→ 谓语跟最近的主语
there be + 并列主语 → be 跟第一个主语
就远：with / together with / as well as / except / but / like 引导的短语 → 谓语只看前面真正的主语
例：Neither you nor he likes… / Tom with his parents has gone to Beijing.
口诀：三剑客贪近，陪衬团念旧

nodes.title: ⑦ 综合验收：六关考点一锅端
nodes.explain:
最后一关，不讲新东西——把前面六关的考点混在一起再过一遍。做错哪题，就回哪一关翻口诀卡。

验收清单：必单数六情况（②）· a number of vs the number of / 陪衬结构（③）· 时间整体 / many a 与 more than one（④）· 两面派 family / means / the + 形容词（⑤）· 就近三剑客（⑥）。
nodes.qs_label: 综合验收（错哪题回哪关）

general_qs.stem: One of my friends ________ (be) from Australia.
general_qs.explain: 回第②关：one of + 复数名词，真正主语是 one → 单数 → is。friends 是 of 的陪衬。

general_qs.stem: 下面哪句是对的？
options: The number of visitors are increasing.
A number of students is from the countryside.
The number of the books is three thousand.
A number of water is wasted here.
general_qs.answer: C. The number of the books is three thousand.
general_qs.explain: 回第③关：the number of = 数量 → 单数，C 对。A 死于 the number of 配了 are；B 死于 a number of（许多）配了 is；D 死于 a number of 只修饰复数可数名词，管不了 water。

general_qs.stem: Nobody except the twins ________ (know) the answer.
general_qs.explain: 回第③关陪衬结构：except the twins 是陪衬，主语 nobody 是 no- 系列不定代词 → 三单 → knows。别被 twins 拽成复数。

general_qs.stem: Seventy miles ________ (be) a long distance.
general_qs.explain: 回第④关：七十英里是一段距离，整体概念 → 单数 → is。

general_qs.stem: More than one student ________ (make) the same mistake before.
general_qs.explain: 回第④关：more than one + 单数名词，核心词是 one → 谓语单数；before 提示现在完成时 → has made。意思上「不止一个学生」，形式上偏认单数。

general_qs.stem: The wounded ________ (be) still in hospital.
general_qs.explain: 回第⑤关：the + 形容词 = 一类人（受伤的人们）→ 复数 → are。

general_qs.stem: Not only the students but also the teacher ________ (be) invited to the party.
general_qs.explain: 回第⑥关：not only…but also 就近，最近的主语 the teacher 单数 → is。和课堂练习里 my parents 复数那题方向相反——全看谁是「近邻」。

general_qs.stem: Our team ________ (be) the best one in our school.
general_qs.explain: 回第⑤关：team 指这支队伍整体（the best one 一个整体）→ 单数 → is。要说队员们个个怎样，才切复数。
